info.title: Observ.ing API
info.description:
HTTP API behind [observ.ing](https://observ.ing), a biodiversity observation app built on the AT Protocol.

Reads come from the appview's index of the network. Writes go to the signed-in user's PDS as AT Protocol records, then reach the index via the firehose, so a newly written record can take a moment to appear in reads.

Authentication is the `session_did` cookie set by the OAuth flow (`/oauth/login`). Endpoints that accept it optionally use it to fill in viewer-specific fields such as `viewerHasLiked`.

get.description: All public occurrences, newest first, with optional filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: taxon
parameters.description:
Only occurrences whose scientific name starts with this text
(case-insensitive).

parameters.name: kingdom
parameters.description: Only occurrences whose community identification is in this kingdom.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description:
Only occurrences whose event date overlaps the window starting on this
day (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Undated occurrences never match a date filter.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description:
Only occurrences whose event date overlaps the window ending on this
day, inclusive (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description:
Comma-separated data-quality criteria every returned occurrence must
meet: `HAS_DATE`, `HAS_LOCATION`, `PRECISE_LOCATION`, `HAS_MEDIA`,
`HAS_CONSENSUS_ID`, or `complete` for all of them.

post.summary: Convert a HEIC photo to JPEG.
post.description:
Takes the raw bytes of a HEIC/HEIF photo and returns it as a JPEG, for
browsers that can't decode HEIC themselves. Called at import time so the
preview, EXIF extraction and species ID all see a JPEG. Authenticated like
species ID: it burns real CPU per request.

requestBody.description: Raw HEIC/HEIF bytes, up to 25 MB

400.description: Not a HEIC/HEIF image, or it could not be decoded

503.description: HEIC conversion is not available on this server

put.description:
Replaces the record on the caller's PDS. The request is the full new state
of the occurrence: omitted optional fields are cleared, and existing media
is kept only if its blob CID is listed in `retainedBlobCids`.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

403.description: The occurrence belongs to someone else

post.description:
Uploads any images to the caller's PDS, writes the occurrence record (plus
remark records for any notes), and, when `scientificName` is given, the
observer's own identification. The occurrence shows up in feeds once the
record reaches the firehose and is indexed.

200.description: The record was written to the caller's PDS

401.description: Not signed in, or the session expired

post.description:
Returns ranked suggestions from the species identification model, each
matched against GBIF where the name resolves. Requires authentication to
prevent abuse.

get.summary: Check whether species identification is warm.
get.description:
Reports whether the species-id service has a warm instance and, if not,
roughly how long until an identify request would come back. The check
itself wakes a cold service, so the frontend calls this as soon as the
user starts a flow that will need an ID (e.g. opening the upload modal)
to get the boot underway while they pick a photo. Authenticated like
`identify` so anonymous traffic can't keep the service awake.

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Check the live-loop (ViT-L) service instead of the full model.

200.description: Whether the service is warm, and if not, roughly how long it will take

CommentRow.description: Comment row returned from SELECT queries

kingdom.description:
Optional kingdom hint from a GBIF autocomplete pick. Disambiguates
genus-level names for the GBIF validate call and acts as a fallback
when validation doesn't return a kingdom of its own.

organismQuantity.description:
Darwin Core dwc:organismQuantity — free text (a count, a range like
"10-100", or a categorical value like "many"). Written verbatim.

organismQuantityType.description:
Darwin Core dwc:organismQuantityType — the quantification system the
quantity uses ("individuals", "percent-cover", or an open-vocab value).

externalRecords.description:
References to this same occurrence held on another service. Capped at
`constants::MAX_EXTERNAL_RECORDS` by the lexicon.

license.description:
License URI applied to each uploaded media record (e.g.
`https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/`). Validated against
`validation::ALLOWED_LICENSES`; a retired SPDX identifier is upgraded to
its URI rather than rejected. When omitted, the PDS media record stores
no license.

kingdom.description:
Optional kingdom hint from a GBIF autocomplete pick. Disambiguates
genus-level names for the auto-identification's GBIF validate call
and acts as a fallback when validation doesn't return a kingdom.

taxonId.description:
Stable taxon URI from a GBIF autocomplete pick (e.g. a GBIF species
URI). Written to the auto-created identification's `taxonID` field.

occurrenceRemarks.description:
Darwin Core dwc:occurrenceRemarks — the observer's own notes on the
organism. Written as a separate `bio.lexicons.temp.v0-1.remark` record
that the occurrence references; blank or omitted writes none.

eventRemarks.description:
Darwin Core dwc:eventRemarks — notes on the time and place. Written the
same way as the occurrence remarks.

ErrorResponse.description: JSON body of every error response.

ExternalRecord.description:
A reference to this occurrence as held by another service — an iNaturalist
observation, a record in another AT Protocol lexicon, and so on. Passed
through verbatim: the appview neither resolves nor validates the target.

service.description:
Short service identifier from the record (`inaturalist`, `bugguide`, an
AT Protocol app name, ...). The lexicon's known values are not
exhaustive, so clients must handle unfamiliar ones.

ExternalRecordInput.description:
One `externalRecords` entry from the submit/edit form: this same occurrence
as held by another service. Both create and update send the full list, so an
edit round-trips whatever the form was populated with.

uri.description:
Permalink of the record on the holding service, or an `at://` URI for a
record in another AT Protocol lexicon.

service.description:
Short service identifier (`inaturalist`, `bugguide`, an app name).
Optional — the client derives it from the URI host where it recognizes
one, and omits it otherwise rather than guessing.

IdentificationRow.description: Identification row returned from SELECT queries

latitude.description:
Where the photo was taken. With `longitude`, lets the model flag
suggestions that are out of range.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return.

live.description:
Route to the faster live-loop model (ViT-L). The continuous camera
preview sets this; the upload/capture re-ID leaves it false so it gets
the full-accuracy model. Falls back to the full model when no live
service is configured.

mimeType.description: Deserialized from frontend but unused — PDS infers MIME type from bytes.

InteractionRow.description: Interaction row returned from SELECT queries

InteractionSubjectRequest.description: One side of an interaction: an occurrence, a taxon, or both.

url.description: Authorization URL on the user's PDS to send the browser to.

id.description: The notification to mark read. Omit to mark all of them read.

oneOf.description: `null` when not signed in or the session has expired.

actorDid.description: DID of the user whose action triggered the notification.

subjectUri.description: AT URI of the viewer's occurrence that was acted on.

referenceUri.description: AT URI of the identification, comment, or like record.

Occurrence.description: Enriched occurrence ready for API response

eventDate.description:
NULL on survey-based occurrences whose `eventDate` lives on the
referenced survey record we don't yet ingest. The explore page
renders a placeholder rather than dropping the observation.

organismQuantity.description:
Darwin Core dwc:organismQuantity — free text (an int/float, or
categorical like "many"/"10-100").

occurrenceRemarks.description:
Darwin Core dwc:occurrenceRemarks — the observer's own notes on the
organism, from the remark record the occurrence references.

eventRemarks.description:
Darwin Core dwc:eventRemarks — the observer's notes on the time and
place, resolved the same way.

externalRecords.description:
References to this same occurrence on other platforms, straight from
the record. Empty for the overwhelming majority of observations.

qualityIssues.description:
Empty means the observation is "verifiable" — pass `?quality=verifiable`
on feed requests to filter to just those rows.

OccurrenceImage.description:
A single image attached to an occurrence, with the license URI the uploader
chose (when one is recorded on the underlying media record).

RecordCreatedResponse.description: Response returned when an AT Protocol record is created.

SpeciesIdStatus.description: Warm/cold state of a species-id service, as reported to the frontend.

estimatedSeconds.description: Rough seconds until an identify request would complete, when cold.

SpeciesSuggestion.description:
A single ranked AI suggestion enriched with the GBIF match (when the
scientific name resolves to a known taxon). The frontend treats a
suggestion with `taxonMatch` set the same as a user picking from the
autocomplete: the kingdom/rank fields disappear and the match indicator
shows "Existing taxon".

SuccessResponse.description: Simple success/failure response with no additional payload.

taxonId.description:
Stable URI for this taxon (e.g. `https://www.gbif.org/species/{key}`),
suitable for Darwin Core dwc:taxonID. `None` when GBIF didn't supply a
backbone key. Distinct from `id`, which is a path-based slug used for
in-app taxon navigation.

organismQuantity.description:
See `CreateOccurrenceRequest::organism_quantity`. Omitting it clears the
value on the record, so the edit form sends back the existing value.

externalRecords.description:
See `CreateOccurrenceRequest::external_records`. The edit form sends the
full list back, so omitting it clears the entries on the record.

images.description: Newly-added images to upload and attach, in addition to any retained ones.

retainedBlobCids.description:
Blob CIDs of existing media records to retain on the updated occurrence.
Media whose CID is not in this list is dropped from the record.

license.description:
License URI to apply to *newly-uploaded* media records on this edit.
Retained media keep whatever license they were originally written with —
silently rewriting historical metadata when a default changes would lose
the user's intent at upload time.

occurrenceRemarks.description:
See `CreateOccurrenceRequest::occurrence_remarks`. Like the other
fields, omitting it clears the remark (and deletes the record), so the
edit form sends back the existing text.

defaultLicense.description: Pass `null` to clear the user's saved default.

basemap.description:
Map basemap id ("outdoor" | "topo" | "streets" | "satellite"). Pass
`null` to clear.

session.name: session_did
session.description: Set by the OAuth callback after signing in via `/oauth/login`.
